fields.name: Third Street Bridge over the Gowanus Canal
fields.description: As of Monday, November 30th, 2026, through Thursday, December 24th, 2026, the bridge will be fully closed between 11pm to 5am Tuesday nights into Wednesday mornings and Thursday night into Friday mornings. The bridge will be fully closed to cyclists, motorists, and pedestrians. These closures are necessary to conduct the continued repairs on the Third Street Bridge over Gowanus Canal.

description.from: As of Sunday October 25th, 2026, through Friday November 20th, 2026, a full northbound and southbound tube will continue to be closed (not at the same time), will take place every week 10pm Sunday night to 5am Friday morning. Traffic will return to its original configuration after work hours. These closures are necessary for the continued work on flood mitigation construction activities on Battery Park Underpass, as permitted by NYCDOT Bridges.
description.to: As of Sunday November 22nd, 2026, through Friday December 18th, 2026, a full northbound and southbound tube will continue to be closed (not at the same time), will take place every week 10pm Sunday night to 5am Friday morning. Traffic will return to its original configuration after work hours. These closures are necessary for the continued work on flood mitigation construction activities on Battery Park Underpass, as permitted by NYCDOT Bridges.

description.from: As of Sunday November 15th, 2026, and intermittently through Tuesday November 24th, 2026, an overnight full bridge closure will take place nightly, Sunday to Tuesday from 11pm to 5am, and daytime Saturdays from 7am to 2pm. The bridge will be fully closed to traffic during these working hours. Metropolitan Avenue may be used as an alternate route. These closures are necessary for continued structural repairs of the Grand Street Bridge over Newtown Creek. permitted by NYCDOT Bridges.
description.to: As of Sunday November 29th, 2026, and intermittently through Saturday December 12th, 2026, an overnight full bridge closure will take place nightly, Sunday to Tuesday from 11pm to 5am, and daytime Saturdays from 7am to 2pm. The bridge will be fully closed to traffic during these working hours. Metropolitan Avenue may be used as an alternate route. These closures are necessary for continued structural repairs of the Grand Street Bridge over Newtown Creek. permitted by NYCDOT Bridges.

description.from: As of Monday November 2nd, 2026,intermittently through Friday November 27th, 2026, a single vehicular lane closure will take place in either Brooklyn-bound or Queens-bound direction (not at the same time) from 11pm to 5am. The Brooklyn-bound travel and bike lane will not be affected. The Queens-bound bike lane will be closed to cyclists. Saturday work may also be required from 7 a.m. to 1 p.m. These closures are necessary for conducting maintenance on Metropolitan Avenue Bridge over Newtown Creek, as permitted by NYCDOT Bridges.
